column1: # How to write each small letter. Same format as english.tsv (LETTER <tab> STROKES, strokes
# separated by ";", points "x,y" in the letter's box, "~" = curve).
# Guide lines in the box: tall letters start at y=0.02, small letters sit between y=0.36
# (top) and y=0.76 (base line); tails go down to y=1.0. Dots are a tiny last stroke.
